description: This file contains JavaScript code for the ISC_Scheduler module, which defines data sources and UI components for managing scheduled jobs and triggers using the SmartClient framework. It includes definitions for QuartzScheduler, QuartzJobs, QuartzTriggers, and a QuartzManager class with associated buttons and grids for job control.

classes.name: QuartzManager
classes.description: A class extending SectionStack that provides UI controls for managing scheduled jobs and triggers, including buttons for pausing, resuming, triggering, adding, and removing jobs and triggers.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the QuartzManager widget, creating buttons and grids for job and trigger management, and adding sections to the UI.
